title: Viral video miscaptioned as a 26 October 2024 London rally
reason: False-positive discovery lead: Reuters verifies the footage depicts an anti-government protest in Minsk in August 2020, not an October 2024 Belarus gathering.
notes: The video was circulating with a London date/location claim. This record is excluded from 2024 Belarus event coding; it is not a candidate event.

title: BGmedia report on 26 October national strike and protests (2020)
reason: Outside the assigned period. The exact opened page is dated 26 October 2020 and reports 2020 events, not October 2024.
notes: The 2024-targeted search returned this stale page. Do not confuse its 2020 protest/strike descriptions with Q4 2024 activity.

title: Planned pro-Lukashenko Minsk rally reported by Hrodna.life (2020)
reason: Outside the assigned period and not an anti-government demand. The 23 October 2020 article says the planned rally was cancelled; no executed gathering is established.
notes: Reported travel requests and counts are prospective, not actual turnout; this is a historical false-positive trace.

title: Marathon of Unity cultural activities in Gomel
reason: Search-result text describes a cultural/political promotional event and dialogue, not a protest or participant demand against Belarusian state policy.
notes: Search-only local union report says the event reached Gomel on 18 October. Attendance is not reported in the captured result; no body was opened.
